'''Kayleigh''' (Japanese: '''カオリ''' ''Kaori'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream!]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]] from [[Brindille Town]].

She was seen competing in the Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]] in [[Lagoon Town]] with her {{p|Furfrou}}. Her performance was going well until a {{TP|Serena|Pancham}} suddenly appeared on the stage and crashed the performance. The Pancham jumped to the ceiling and grabbed a stage lamp, only to pull it down. As Pancham fell back onto the stage, Kayleigh ran off the stage in fear.

|desc={{p|Furfrou}} is Kayleigh's only known Pokémon. It dons the [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Furfrou|Dandy Trim]].

It competed with its {{pkmn|Trainer}} in a Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]]. For their performance, Kayleigh had Furfrou leap through a hula hoop. After this, Furfrou used Double Team to show off its moves. Before the performance could continue, however, a {{TP|Serena|Pancham}} appeared onstage and began imitating Furfrou's moves. After Pancham broke a stage lamp and fell on the stage, Furfrou and its Trainer ran off the stage in fear.

Furfrou's only known move is {{m|Double Team}}.}}
